q: What is UGC, and why does it convert better than studio ads?
a: UGC (user-generated content) is video made by real creators in a native, first-person style: unboxings, try-ons, reviews and "hauls". It reads like a recommendation from a person rather than an ad from a brand, which is exactly what short-form feeds reward. Read our full guide to UGC ads.
